text:
noah: Quick sync: spinning a 3% canary on rwd-v6-int4 for prod bring-up. Observed a long-doc ( >3k tokens ) slice drop on the first window, MRR -1.8, p95 +10%. Want to lock down exclusion + rollback semantics before we proceed.
priya: Can you share the numbers? exacts help define thresholds.
noah: Window1 aggs: global_mrr_delta: -0.006, longdoc_slice.mrr: -0.018, p95_ms: 240 -> 264 (+10%), halluc_rate delta: +0.05pp. sample_count longdoc=420.
emma: Two immediate asks: 1) enforce min-samples per slice (>=500) to take hard action; 2) for longdocs require kv-warmup success metric before >5% traffic.
randy: Agree. Also propose split of trigger types: degrade (soft) vs fail (hard). Soft = pause stepping and spawn shadow compare + human sample n=200. Hard = rollback.
noah: Draft policy (machine-readable snippet):
```
canary:
  start_pct: 3
  step_pct: 2
  step_wait_mins: 20
  max_pct: 20
  kv_warmup_required_tokens: 2048
  min_samples_per_slice: 500
  soft_triggers:
    slice_mrr_drop_pct: 1.0  # relative pct (e.g., 1.0 == 1%)
    sample_floor: 200
    action: pause_and_shadow
  hard_triggers:
    slice_mrr_drop_pct: 2.5
    p95_increase_frac: 0.25
    hallucination_pp: 0.75
    action: immediate_rollback
  longdoc_guard:
    exclude_initial: true
    include_after_kv_warmup: true
cooldown_mins: 90
audit_tags_on_rollback: true
```
Note: sample_floor under soft_triggers is for spawning human review even if min_samples isn't hit.
priya: Nice. For safety-critical slices (legal, compliance, contracts) we should tighten soft_triggers to 0.5% and keep them excluded initially. Add an allowlist/denylist semantics.
emma: Add metric smoothing: evaluate rolling average across last 3 windows to avoid transient flips. Also make sure p95 is computed on successful responses only.
randy: ops note: deploy-bot sees promote attempt with rule 'longctx-guard-v1'.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: apply request received for rwd-v6-int4 with canary policy longctx-guard-v1.
alert-bot: alert-bot: alerted INC-2042 - longdoc slice MRR below threshold sample_count=420 (below min 500).
noah: Plan: exclude long-doc and legal slices from initial run, start at 3%, step 2% every 20m after kv_warm validated and sample floors met. I'll open Gatebook PR for these semantics and include rollout yaml.
priya: Please include escalation runbook: if hard trigger then notify SRE + ML lead and auto-tag rollback_reason=canary:longdoc-mrr. Include link to shadow job for human raters.
emma: I'll prepare the human evaluation template for the shadow job (200 exemplars, focus on hallucinations & answer completeness).
randy: tagging @oncall for awareness.
noah: Will push promote config and PR: https://github.com/redwood/gatebook/pull/4218. I'll post results in this thread after 2 windows.
priya: Thx. If longdoc sample count stays <500, we should keep it excluded and run large-scale offline eval instead of auto decisions.
noah: Ack. Updating config now. Will report back in ~45m.
